description: This file contains a suite of shell script tests for verifying the behavior of 'git svn init' and 'git svn clone' commands, including handling different repository layouts, prefix configurations, and initialization options. It uses a testing framework with functions like 'test_expect_success' and manages a temporary SVN repository setup for testing.

methods.name: test_svn_configured_prefix
methods.description: Verifies the SVN remote fetch/refspec configuration matches expected prefix mappings.
